title: Halo 4: Forward Unto Dawn (Special Edition)
overview: The Forward Unto Dawn Special Edition contains the complete, official film-length cut of Forward Unto Dawn as well as additional material. The film is set 31 years before Halo 4 and follows Thomas Lasky, occurring in the early days of the Human-Covenant War circa 2526. Lasky, a young cadet at Corbulo Academy of Military Science, must conquer his inner fears and join forces with super-soldier John-117 to take down a massive faction of the Covenant.
